entries.65051f1bea22b8be9429d010f1572682d3f38815: <div sID="gen19304" type="x-p"/> <chapter n="48" osisID="Ezek.48" sID="Ezek.48"/> <div eID="gen19304" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen19305" type="x-p"/> In this chapter we have particular directions given for the distribution of the land, of which we had the metes and bounds assigned in the foregoing chapter. I. The portions of the twelve tribes, seven to the north of the sanctuary (<reference osisRef="Ezek.48.1-Ezek.48.7">ver. 1-7</reference>) and five to the south, <reference osisRef="Ezek.48.23-Ezek.48.29">ver. 23-29</reference>. II. The allotment of land for the sanctuary, and the priests (<reference osisRef="Ezek.48.8-Ezek.48.11">ver. 8-11</reference>), for the Levites (<reference osisRef="Ezek.48.12-Ezek.48.14">ver. 12-14</reference>), for the city (<reference osisRef="Ezek.48.15-Ezek.48.20">ver. 15-20</reference>), and for the prince, <reference osisRef="Ezek.48.21-Ezek.48.22">ver. 21, 22</reference>. Much of this we had before, <reference osisRef="Ezek.45.1-Ezek.45.25">ch. xlv.</reference> III. A plan of the city, its gates, and the new name given to it (<reference osisRef="Ezek.48.30-Ezek.48.35">ver. 30-35</reference>), which seals up, and concludes, the vision and prophecy of this book.

(<hi type="small-caps">b. c.</hi> 574.)</title> <div sID="gen19306" type="x-p"/> <hi type="super">1</hi> Now these <hi type="italic">are</hi> the names of the tribes. type="italic">shall be</hi> the measures thereof; the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred. <hi type="super">17</hi> And the suburbs of the city shall be toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty. <hi type="super">18</hi> And the residue in length over against the oblation of the holy <hi type="italic">portion
